sensor_mast.name: Survey Mast
sensor_mast.blurb: A spine ahead of the keel. You are longer, a little louder, and you see farther.

cargo_blister.name: Cargo Blister
cargo_blister.blurb: A swollen hold on each flank. She carries a real haul and turns like a loaded barge.

gun_sponson.name: Keel Sponson
gun_sponson.blurb: An angular gun cheek. Heavier to yaw. Meaner at the range you already reach.

battery_pack.name: Battery Pack
battery_pack.blurb: A cased bank of cells on the deck, cabled into the bus. Spare climbs. Mass climbs with it.

armor_belt.name: Armor Belt
armor_belt.blurb: Overlapping plates wrapped on the flanks and bolted through the skin. Wider, heavier, a little louder.
